question: In terms of total number of passengers, which was the largest airport in India in the year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi International Airport (Delhi).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indira Gandhi International Airport (Delhi):-**

 
 
• **In the year 2022, Indira Gandhi International Airport (Delhi) had the most passengers and aircraft movements.**
 
• Indira Gandhi International Airport has undergone significant expansion and modernization in recent years, which has helped it handle more passengers and aircraft movements.
 
• The airport has also implemented various measures to improve the passenger experience, such as self-check-in kiosks, automated baggage handling, and a wide range of dining and shopping options.
 
• Delhi is home to several major airlines, including Air India and IndiGo, which operate numerous flights from the airport.
